                        -- tier + other artists like Raffi/Seeger will add more), so left open

    source_id   INTEGER,

search_chunks_ai

CREATE TRIGGER search_chunks_ai AFTER INSERT ON search_chunks BEGIN
    INSERT INTO search_chunks_fts (rowid, id, kind, title, chunk_text, lyrics, instructions, source_path)
    VALUES (new.rowid, new.id, new.kind, new.title, new.chunk_text, new.lyrics, new.instructions, new.source_path);
  END

objects.name: search_chunks_au
objects.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER search_chunks_au AFTER UPDATE ON search_chunks BEGIN
    UPDATE search_chunks_fts
    SET id = new.id,
        kind = new.kind,
        title = new.title,
        chunk_text = new.chunk_text,
        lyrics = new.lyrics,
        instructions = new.instructions,
        source_path = new.source_path
    WHERE rowid = new.rowid;
  END

objects.name: topic_materials_resource_reference_insert
objects.sql: CREATE TRIGGER topic_materials_resource_reference_insert BEFORE INSERT ON topic_materials WHEN NEW.material_kind = 'resource' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM resources WHERE id = NEW.material_id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'topic_materials resource must reference resources.id'); END
